description: UI-focused developer working on a dashboard redesign. Talks in visual/design terms, component structure, accessibility. Warmer tone than the backend persona, still concrete.

messages.text: Let's go with Tailwind for styling instead of the old CSS modules setup.
We chose Zustand for state management over Redux for the new dashboard.
Decision: all new components live under src/components/ui, no more scattering.
I prefer colocating a component's test file right next to it.
Please always add an aria-label to icon-only buttons.
We can't use client-side only rendering for the pricing page, it needs to be crawlable.
Actually, the breakpoint for tablet is 768px, not 820px like the old spec said.
The correct value for the primary brand color is #1a73e8, design just corrected it.
We tried CSS-in-JS with runtime styles but it didn't work well with our SSR setup.
Failed approach: a single global Redux store for everything, way too much boilerplate.
Check src/components/ui/Button.tsx for the button variants pattern.
See https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/dashboard-redesign for the latest mocks — everyone just calls it 'the figma file' in Slack.
Never ship a component without a loading and an error state.
